estonia.title: Estonia's youth jobs paradox: Firms struggle to find workers
estonia.description: Estonian employers report staff shortages despite high youth unemployment, pointing to a mismatch between the skills young people have and those companies need.

estonia.title: President: Closing Estonian-Russian border cannot be an emotional decision
estonia.description: Decisions on whether to close the Estonian-Russian border must be made based on an analysis of the economic, humanitarian, diplomatic and security implications, President Ülle Madise said.

estonia.title: Estonia backs EU deportation center in Rwanda but won't join
estonia.description: Five European Union member states are planning to establish a deportation center in Rwanda where people without a legal basis to remain in Europe could be sent in the future. Estonia supports the concept behind the pilot project but is not currently participating in it.

estonia.title: Hipodroomi intersection to open to traffic in both directions over winter
estonia.description: The Hipodroomi intersection in Tallinn's Kristiine is set to reopen both lanes on Paldiski maantee over winter, and construction work will resume next spring.

estonia.title: Tallinn bar security guards sentenced to 13 years for robberies
estonia.description: Harju District Court on Tuesday found 30-year-old Ruslan Hrapko and 26-year-old Vladislav Kirillov guilty of assaulting and robbing intoxicated people while working as security guards at bars in Tallinn's Old Town. The court sentenced both men to 13 years in prison.

estonia.title: Podcast host and author: Health is about more than diet and exercise
estonia.description: The pressure to live a healthy, happy life can feel like a full-time job, but podcast host and author Kaidi Klein says balance and mental well-being are just as important.

estonia.title: 'Unicorn' caught on Saaremaa wildlife camera
estonia.description: A trail cam on the island of Saaremaa captured the unusual sight of a "unicorn" – in reality a deer which seems to have a single antler in the center of its head, Maaleht reported.

estonia.title: Committee chair: Procurement rules broken in defense contracts
estonia.description: The Riigikogu's anti-corruption select committee on Monday reviewed documents and correspondence at the Ministry of Defense related to Datasel. Many questions remain unanswered, committee chair Anastassia Kovalenko-Kõlvart said.

estonia.title: Artists' union re-elects leaders after falling victim to financial fraud
estonia.description: The Estonian Artists' Association re-elected its previous leadership at an extraordinary general assembly, returning Maarin Ektermann as president and Tüüne-Kristin Vaikla as vice president.

estonia.title: Scabies cases surge across Estonia as treatment proves tricky
estonia.description: Estonia is seeing a surge in scabies cases, with doctors warning that reinfection and treatment failures are making the infestation difficult to contain.

estonia.title: Estonia's men's football team finish 2026 with a win, beating Bulgaria 2–1
estonia.description: Estonia beat Bulgaria 2–1 at home Monday night, ending the year and their UEFA Nations League Group L campaign with a win.

estonia.title: Man 'steals' bus from driver in Tallinn, crashes it after driving off
estonia.description: A man who attacked a bus driver in Tallinn over the weekend then stole the same bus, driving off with it and causing thousands of euros of damage to the vehicle after crashing.

estonia.title: Illegal cigarette factory busted by police and customs board
estonia.description: Eleven people have been detained by the police and officials from the Tax and Customs Board (MTA) on suspicion of large-scale illegal handling of tobacco products.

estonia.title: Dentist: No store-bought whitening product can actually brighter your teeth
estonia.description: Store-bought teeth-whitening products may be ineffective or even harmful and people should consult a dentist before attempting to whiten their teeth at home, dentist Anasstasia Kuldmaa warns.

estonia.title: FM: More US troops needed on Europe's eastern flank
estonia.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs Margus Tsahkna (Reform) said the United States' official plans will become clear by the beginning of winter, after U.S. outlet Bloomberg reported that U.S. troop cuts in Europe will be smaller than feared.

estonia.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia is closing the Estonia-Russia border
estonia.description: Estonia cannot allow Russia to use our openness against our own security, writes Tarmo Miilits.

estonia.title: Estonian basketball coach loses appeal over referee clash 5-game ban
estonia.description: The Estonian Basketball Association (Eesti Korvpalliliit) has rejected an appeal from the coach of a top basketball team over a ban issued after an altercation with a referee.

estonia.title: EU packaging rules threaten to cut off Estonia from smaller European suppliers
estonia.description: An Estonian lighting manufacturer urges the Ministry of Climate to address the problem of small European suppliers refusing to send goods to Estonia over EU packaging rules.

estonia.title: Risto Abel: The state should build roads, not apartments
estonia.description: The government plans to build 1,000 apartments in rural areas to address a market failure. The problem is real, but the solution is wrong, writes Risto Abel. The state's role should be to create the necessary conditions, and developers will follow on their own.

estonia.title: Gallery founder: A little scandal helps sell art
estonia.description: This autumn's art auction season in Estonia has been exceptionally successful, with more than €6 million worth of art already sold, says gallerist Siim Raie. In his view, scandals that have attracted attention in the art world have brought new buyers to auctions and helped boost sales.

estonia.title: New research method promises to shed light on Estonia's oldest steel finds
estonia.description: New archaeological evidence suggests iron production in Estonia may have begun several centuries earlier than previously thought. University of Tartu researcher Kristo Oks is using modern chemical analysis and experimental archaeology to investigate the origins of Estonia's earliest iron and steel artifacts.

estonia.title: Migratory birds sticking around in Estonia as fall weather remains mild
estonia.description: Some migratory birds are staying in Estonia rather than heading south this fall, as mild weather and plentiful food allow them to delay or skip their usual migration.

estonia.title: Researcher: Russia controlling the Americans in the Ukraine peace process
estonia.description: Russia is calling the shots for the Americans in the Ukraine peace process, with Washington's desire to establish business ties with Moscow contributing to the situation, ICDS research fellow Marek Kohv said.

estonia.title: Poll puts Social Democrats ahead of Isamaa as Reform support falls to 9%
estonia.description: Another survey, conducted by Turu-uuringute, has put the Social Democrats (SDE) ahead of Isamaa in terms of support.

estonia.title: Tallinn looks to add class for teens still not enrolled in school
estonia.description: Tallinn has asked the Education Ministry to approve an extra preparatory class for 15 of 81 city teens still not enrolled despite being required to continue their education.

estonia.title: Prorector: Using AI to evaluate research funding applications could affect entire system
estonia.description: The Estonian Research Council is testing the use of artificial intelligence to evaluate research funding applications, prompting concerns from the University of Tartu over transparency, fairness and data protection.

estonia.title: Estonian-Russian border crossings have dropped considerably since 2022
estonia.description: The number of times people have crossed the Russian border has fallen from over 4 million before 2022 to around 760,000 so far this year.

estonia.title: Estonia's eastern border closure will stop bus and truck traffic to Russia
estonia.description: Estonia's plan to close its land border crossings with Russia in December will force bus companies to discontinue routes from Tallinn to St. Petersburg and Moscow.

estonia.title: Photos: Truck crash jams outbound traffic on Tallinn's Tartu maantee
estonia.description: A truck crashed into a lamppost on Tartu maantee and got stuck under an overpass Monday afternoon, disrupting outbound traffic at a busy Tallinn junction ahead of rush hour.

estonia.title: Mayor: Narva fears humanitarian and economic consequences of the border closure
estonia.description: Narva Mayor Jaan Toots (Center Party) says that if the Estonian-Russian border is completely closed, border controls should also be reinstated on the Latvian border.

estonia.title: Professor: New power generation should accompany data center construction
estonia.description: Large data centers planned for Estonia could end up consuming a significant share of the country's electricity, says Mart Landsberg, a professor at Tallinn University of Technology. The most important question is how much added value can be created with that energy.

estonia.title: Foreign Ministry summons Russian chargé d'affaires
estonia.description: Estonia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has summoned Russia's chargé d'affaires to express its strong condemnation of the attempted arson attack carried out against defense industry company Threod Systems on Saturday night.

estonia.title: Auditor general: Pension hikes won't hinge on state budget being passed
estonia.description: Pensions in Estonia will rise next year even if the Riigikogu fails to pass the 2027 state budget in December, says Auditor General Janar Holm.

estonia.title: Saaremaa shipyard to launch largest Estonian-built warship
estonia.description: An experimental 45-meter military vessel will be launched at the Baltic Workboats shipyard on Saaremaa on November 18.

estonia.title: Kaspar Viilup: Pop culture wave of "GTA VI" will be felt for a long time
estonia.description: The new "Grand Theft Auto" video game, more than a decade in the making, is just days away, and while the Estonian media still struggles to cover gaming as thoroughly as it should, the impact of this pop culture tidal wave can hardly be overstated, Kaspar Viilup writes.

estonia.title: Kaja Kallas' role in Ukraine peace talks unclear
estonia.description: Responding to an ERR question about her inclusion in Europe's negotiating team, Kaja Kallas said the decision was up to European Union leaders and that she would continue working on the substantive issues in the negotiations regardless.

estonia.title: Kukerpillid gearing up for ambitious thank-you tour across Estonia
estonia.description: After 54 years, Estonian folk legends Kukerpillid are taking on their most ambitious tour yet, with shows in all 15 counties next spring to thank audiences across the country.

estonia.title: Tiit Maran: Climate law needs substance, not impressive-sounding title
estonia.description: In the future, instead of pursuing a climate law, Estonia should consider whether it would be more sensible to create a new framework law on sustainable development, writes Tiit Maran.

estonia.title: Estonian police detain Thai woman suspected of sexually exploiting workers
estonia.description: The authorities detained a 48-year-old Thai woman suspected of sexually exploiting employees by forcing Thai women working at a massage parlor to provide sexual services.

estonia.title: Minister: Closing the border with Russia directly affects few people
estonia.description: Closing the border with Russia will affect only a small number of people and a handful of businesses, Minister of Interior Igor Taro (Eesti 200) said on Monday, as preparations are underway to shutter land crossing points at the start of December. The railway crossing in Narva is expected to stay open.

estonia.title: Egyptian citizen faces 1 year in prison for transporting migrants from Latvia to Estonia
estonia.description: A 24-year-old Egyptian citizen has been handed a one-year prison sentence under a plea agreement for transporting five foreign nationals from Latvia to Estonia who had no legal basis for staying in the country.

estonia.title: Early music festival returns with centuries-old sounds across Estonia
estonia.description: The Tallinn feat. Reval early music festival returns November 21–29, with a series of concerts on tap across Tallinn, Tartu, Otepää and the Arvo Pärt Center in Laulasmaa.

estonia.title: What is the real impact of 300 disappearing jobs in Ida-Viru County?
estonia.description: Eesti Energia's announced mass layoffs could have consequences far beyond the loss of jobs, affecting the local economy, demographics and social services.

estonia.title: Former mayor: Closure of Estonia-Russia border a painful blow for Narva
estonia.description: "The closure of the Estonian-Russian border is not a great surprise, but it is a painful development for the border city of Narva. People had always hoped it would not happen," former Narva Mayor Katri Raik wrote on social media.

estonia.title: Gallery: Estonian artists show off diverse watercolor styles in annual show
estonia.description: An annual exhibition featuring 44 Estonian watercolor artists opened in Viljandi on Saturday, with participating artists given free rein to select their own works for display.

estonia.title: Estonia's third quarter unemployment rate up to 7.9 percent
estonia.description: Estonia's unemployment rate rose to 7.9 percent in the third quarter as employment fell, with young people and older workers among those most affected.

estonia.title: E-voting no longer gives advantage to candidates at bottom of election lists
estonia.description: In the early years of online voting, candidates at the top of electoral lists received a larger share of votes cast on paper than online. Two decades later, that gap has disappeared.

estonia.title: Apartment association wins against insurance company in fire damage dispute
estonia.description: Harju District Court has dismissed an insurer's claim seeking to recover compensation paid out following a fire at an apartment building on Pae tänav in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Security service: Russia targeting around 10 Estonian defense companies
estonia.description: The Estonian Internal Security Service (ISS/KAPO) had advance intelligence about the recent attack on Threod Systems and is working closely with the defense industry to prevent further incidents, Director General Margo Palloson told ERR.

estonia.title: Estonian military officer: Command system was key to success of Ukraine's Ust-Luga attacks
estonia.description: Ukraine's major attack on Russia's Ust-Luga port last week succeeded thanks to an impressive command-and-control system, Estonian Defense Forces Lt. Col. Marten Suur told ERR.

estonia.title: KESKTORMAJAD ⟩ «Aivar Pohlakul oli õigus!»
estonia.description: Postimehe jalgpalliteemalise taskuhäälingu «KESKTORMAJAD» 106. episoodis tuli teemaks nii Eesti meeste kui ka U19 noormeeste koondise vägitükid. Seejuures tuli tõdeda, et jalgpalliliidu presidendil Aivar Pohlakul oli õigus.

estonia.title: Riigikohus ei võtnud Eestist välja saadetud metropoliit Eugeni kaebust menetlusse
estonia.description: Riigikohus otsustas teisipäeval, 17. novembril, mitte võtta menetlusse Moskvale alluva õigeusu kiriku endise juhi metropoliit Eugeni ehk Valeri Rešetnikovi kassatsioonkaebust.

estonia.title: Praha raudteejaama lähedal põrkas kokku kaks rongi
estonia.description: Praha keskraudteejaama lähedal põrkas teisipäeval hommikuse tipptunni ajal kokku kaks rongi. Õnnetuses sai viga mitukümmend inimest.

estonia.title: Politseijuht: piiripunktide sulgemisel piirivalvurid tööta ei jää
estonia.description: Politsei- ja piirivalveameti (PPA) peadirektori asetäitja piirivalve alal Veiko Kommusaare sõnul korraldavad nad Eesti-Venemaa piiripunktide sulgemisel piirivalvurite töö ümber.

estonia.title: Air Balticul võib lisarahastuseta detsembris raha otsa saada
estonia.description: Läti riiklikul lennufirmal Air Baltic võib lisarahastuseta raha otsa saada detsembri esimeses pooles, mis sunniks ettevõtet tegevuse lõpetama ja alustama likvideerimist, selgub firma poolt USA New Yorgi lõunapiirkonna pankrotikohtule esitatud dokumentidest.

estonia.title: MM-sarjas said kaks kuud enne hooaja algust lõpuks reeglid paika
estonia.description: Rahvusvaheline autoliidu (FIA) autoralli maailmameistrivõistluste komisjon kiitis heaks reeglite muudatused eelseisvaks MM-sarja hooajaks.

estonia.title: MÕJUKATE TUND ⟩ Kersti Kaljulaid: riigikogulaste palk võiks olla neli eesti keskmist
estonia.description: President Kersti Kaljulaid ütles KuKu raadio saates «Mõjukate Tund», et läheb poliitikasse alles siis kui päriselt saaks riigi funktsioonid ja rahakoti üle vaadata. Tema sõnul on jõuliselt võimalik kärpida, näiteks saaks EIS-i laiali saata ning osa selle funktsioonidest anda pankadele. Aga praegu puudub kärpimiseks selleks igasugune poliitiline tahe.

estonia.title: Millist kütust tanklad tegelikult müüvad? Kontrollid näitavad vaid üksikuid rikkumisi
estonia.description: Kuigi liigub hulga legende kehvast kütusest, mis automootoreid rikub, näitavad kontrollid pigem vastupidist pilti.

estonia.title: Maailma kunagine uhkeim reisilaev uputati meelega merepõhja, et luua hiiglaslik kunstlik tehisrahu
estonia.description: Üks maailma kuulsamaid ookeanilaevu, ligi 300 meetri pikkune SS United States, uputati 11. novembril Florida ranniku lähedal Mehhiko lahte. Tegemist ei olnud õnnetuse, vaid hoolikalt kavandatud operatsiooniga, mille eesmärk oli muuta ajalooline luksuslaev maailma suurimaks tehisrahuks ehk kunstlikuks mereelupaigaks.

latvia.title: US proposes Ukraine cede territory in exchange for joining NATO: Zelenskyy
latvia.description: Moscow also rejected a proposed ceasefire on energy attacks, Zelenskyy said, warning of further Russian aggression

latvia.title: Finland shuts down Russia’s NATO exit fantasy
latvia.description: 'No way,' says Finland over 'absolutely outrageous' Russian demands

latvia.title: Kapitány István kirúgta a paksi atomerőmű vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: A miniszter azt ígérte, hogy hamarosan bemutatja az erőmű új vezetőjét.

latvia.title: Az Nvidiát nem hatja meg Trump és az aláírásgyűjtés, nem vennék vissza Jensen Huangot
latvia.description: Egyelőre nincs szó arról, hogy visszaengednék a kémbotrányba belebukott egykori vezérigazgatót az Nvidia élére – írja a Politico.

latvia.title: Kapitány István kirúgta Paks I. vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: Horváth Péter János megbízatása azonnali hatállyal szűnik meg.

latvia.title: Fidesz: Magyar Péter kérjen bocsánatot Varga Judittól és minden nőtől
latvia.description: Szentkirályi Alexandra szerint Magyar Péter erőszakos, bántalmazó párkapcsolatban tartotta a feleségét, fenyegette és zsarolta.

latvia.title: Több orosz drón csapódott be Munkácson, kedden és szerdán nem mennek át a határon a magyarországi vonatok
latvia.description: Áldozatok nincsenek, a drónok egy részét az ukrán légvédelem még becsapódás előtt hatástalanította.

latvia.title: Kapitány István felmentette az MVM Paksi Atomerőmű Zrt. vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: Az új vezetőt hamarosan bemutatja.

latvia.title: Véget ért a légiriadó Kárpátalján, megszólalt a katonai adminisztráció
latvia.description: A Mávinform eközben jelezte, az Ukrajna felé tartó vonatok Csapig közlekednek.

latvia.title: Több mint 143 milliárd forint korrigált adózás előtti eredményt ért el az MBH Bank az idei első három negyedévben
latvia.description: Megőrizték szilárd tőke- és likviditási pozíciójukat.

latvia.title: Vonatok ütköztek össze a prágai főpályaudvarnál, több mint negyvenen megsérültek
latvia.description: Leállt a vasúti közlekedés.

latvia.title: Kapitány István azonnali hatállyal menesztette a paksi atomerőmű igazgatóját
latvia.description: Azonnali hatállyal menesztette Horváth Péter Jánost, az MVM Paksi Atomerőmű Zrt. vezérigazgatóját Kapitány István gazdasági és energetikai miniszter. A tárcavezető a döntés okát nem indokolta. Horváth 2023 januárjában, még az Orbán-kormány idején került az atomerőmű élére, ahol fő feladata a paksi blokkok további üzemidő-hosszabbításának előkészítése volt.

latvia.title: Polska coraz bliżej Nuclear Sharing? Szef MON Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz o szczegółach
latvia.description: Efekty są bardzo dobre akurat dla Polski, ale to wymaga już największej dyskrecji - powiedział szef MON Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, pytany o zaangażowanie Polski w program Nuclear Sharing. Przekazał, że ustalenia w tej sprawie zostały podjęte na szczycie NATO w lipcu w Ankarze.

latvia.title: Unia Europejska zyskuje, Polska lekko traci. Nowe prognozy Brukseli
latvia.description: Komisja Europejska podwyższyła prognozę wzrostu gospodarczego Unii Europejskiej na 2026 rok, a jednocześnie nieznacznie obniżyła przewidywania dla Polski na 2027 rok. Wyraźnie pogorszyły się natomiast prognozy dotyczące przyszłorocznej inflacji oraz deficytu sektora finansów publicznych w Polsce.

latvia.title: Co zrobić w razie ataku Rosji? Większość Polaków wskazała jedną odpowiedź
latvia.description: Jak należy reagować na potencjalne rosyjskie ataki? Czy mamy pewność, że sojusznicy nam pomogą? Co sami byśmy zrobili w razie zbrojnego ataku? Najnowsze badanie CBOS pokazuje, że pierwszy raz od 2024 roku najwięcej ankietowanych Polaków uważa atak Rosji na państwa NATO za raczej nieprawdopodobny.

latvia.title: Falošní policajti a advokáti cielia na dôverčivých seniorov. V Trnavskom kraji rastie počet nebezpečných telefonátov
latvia.description: Na západnom Slovensku pribúdajú telefonické podvody na senioroch. Podvodníci v úlohe policajtov a advokátov zneužívajú strach o rodinu a snažia sa získať peniaze.

latvia.title: Revizuirea efectivelor militare ale SUA din Europa, în centrul unor discuții dintre aliații NATO și adjunctul de la Pentagon
latvia.description: Aliații NATO vor discuta marți cu Elbridge Colby, șeful departamentului de politici al Pentagonului, despre revizuirea de către Washington a efectivelor militare americane din Europa, a declarat ministrul german al apărării, Boris Pistorius, urmând ca în câteva săptămâni să se ofere mai multe detalii cu privire la amploarea unei eventuale reduceri, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: NATO își pregătește trupele de elită după modelul ucrainean. Soldații renunță la cele mai noi tehnologii pentru a supraviețui pe front
latvia.description: Forțele speciale ale NATO își schimbă radical metodele de antrenament, după ce războiul din Ucraina a demonstrat că tehnologia militară avansată poate deveni o vulnerabilitate pe câmpul de luptă.

latvia.title: Japonia a ridicat avioanele de vânătoare după ce două aeronave, presupuse a fi ruseşti, au pătruns în spaţiul său aerian
latvia.description: Japonia a anunţat marţi că a mobilizat avioane de vânătoare după ce două aeronave, presupuse a fi ruseşti, i-au încălcat spaţiul aerian şi a înaintat un „protest foarte ferm” către Moscova, anunţă France24.

latvia.title: Copiii și adolescenții văd aproape 4.000 de reclame la alimente pe an. 92% dintre produsele promovate sunt nesănătoase, arată un studiu
latvia.description: Copiii și adolescenții din Statele Unite sunt expuși anual la aproape 4.000 de mesaje publicitare despre alimente și băuturi pe platformele digitale, iar aproximativ 92% dintre produsele alimentare analizate nu îndeplinesc criteriile nutriționale pentru o alimentație sănătoasă.

latvia.title: NATO a anulat summitul din 2027 din Albania. Ce urmează pentru reuniunile liderilor Alianței
latvia.description: NATO a anulat summitul liderilor statelor membre, planificat inițial pentru anul viitor la Tirana, capitala Albaniei, a confirmat Edi Rama, prim-ministrul albanez. Secretarul general Mark Rutte a declarat că Alianța este „flexibilă” și va organiza un summit al liderilor atunci când va fi necesar, scrie TVPWorld.

latvia.title: Dan Neculăescu, întâlnire cu şeful diplomaţiei poloneze: „România şi Polonia rămân doi piloni strategici pe Flancul Estic”
latvia.description: Dan Neculăescu a discutat luni cu vicepremierul şi ministrul de externe al Poloniei, Radoslaw Sikorski, în marja reuniunii Consiliului Afaceri Externe, desfăşurată la Bruxelles. Ministrul Afacerilor Externe a subliniat importanţa cooperării dintre cele două state şi a coordonării pe Flancul Estic al NATO.

latvia.title: PSD cere restructurarea instituţiilor şi companiilor de stat înainte de bugetul pe 2027: „Statul strânge cureaua, nu cetăţenii”
latvia.description: Senatorii PSD susţin adoptarea bugetului de stat pentru anul 2027 după realizarea unei reforme administrative care să reducă cheltuielile publice şi să elimine instituţiile şi companiile de stat ineficiente sau ale căror atribuţii se suprapun. Social-democraţii afirmă că reorganizarea aparatului public trebuie să aibă loc înainte de definitivarea proiectului de buget.

latvia.title: Peiu, după ce România nu a obținut șefia Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei: „De ce s-a asumat un obiectiv atât de straniu?”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a criticat luni „obiectivul straniu” asumat de România de a susţine candidatura lui Dacian Cioloş pentru funcţia de secretar general al Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei.

latvia.title: Harta verde de la Vânătorii Mici se extinde: Pădurea DIGI crește cu încă 6.100 de puieți
latvia.description: Vineri, 13 noiembrie, localitatea Vânătorii Mici din județul Giurgiu a găzduit, pentru al treilea an consecutiv, o nouă mobilizare a voluntarilor Grupului DIGI, dedicată regenerării unei parcele neproductive, afectate de secetă și eroziune. Reuniți sub umbrela campaniei “Pădurea DIGI. Fiecare copac, o schimbare”, 115 angajați și-au canalizat energia și eforturile pentru a îmbogăți cu peste 6.000 de puieți arealul forestier din sudul țării, alături de Asociația Act for Tomorrow, partenerul inițiativei încă de la lansare.

latvia.title: Turos Lóránd, despre reforma administrativă propusă de PSD: „Nu poți redesena localitățile dintr-un birou din București”
latvia.description: Reforma administrativ-teritorială propusă de PSD reprezintă „o amenințare" pentru fiecare comunitate locală din România, nu pentru UDMR, susține liderul senatorilor Uniunii, Turos Lóránd. Acesta cere ca reorganizarea să se bazeze pe date și analize tehnice și să fie realizată numai după consultarea cetățenilor și organizarea unor referendumuri în localitățile afectate.

latvia.title: Isărescu, bilanț la aproape 20 de ani de la aderarea la UE: „A fost șansa noastră”. Cele două mari restanțe ale României
latvia.description: România nu a reușit, în aproape două decenii de apartenență la Uniunea Europeană, să își conecteze toate regiunile prin infrastructură și să adere la zona euro, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a descris aderarea la UE drept un „proiect istoric" și „șansa" pe care România a valorificat-o, dar a atras atenția asupra investițiilor și reformelor rămase nefinalizate.

latvia.title: Guvernatorul BNR respinge scenariul unui acord cu FMI: „Fondul vine când avem o criză valutară. Nu este cazul României"
latvia.description: România nu se află în situația de a apela la un acord de finanțare cu Fondul Monetar Internațional, deoarece nu traversează o criză valutară și dispune de rezerve, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a precizat că țara are nevoie de finanțare, însă banii trebuie să vină din investiții străine, fonduri europene și împrumuturi de pe piețele de capital.

latvia.title: BNR a revizuit în sus prognoza de inflație. Mugur Isărescu: „Energia și carburanții au împins estimările în creștere”
latvia.description: Banca Națională a României a revizuit în creștere traiectoria prognozată a inflației, în principal din cauza scumpirii energiei și carburanților, a anunțat luni guvernatorul Mugur Isărescu. Rata anuală a inflației este așteptată să urce ușor până la sfârșitul anului, apoi să scadă aproape continuu și să revină în intervalul țintei în primul trimestru din 2028. Guvernatorul BNR a afirmat că prețurile de sărbători ar putea rămâne relativ stabile sau ar putea avea creșteri normale, fără scumpiri exagerate.

latvia.title: Dezbateri aprinse pe tema comasării județelor. Dragoș Benea: „Referendumurile nu ar face altceva decât să compromită reorganizarea”
latvia.description: Într-o intervenție telefonică la Digi24, Dragoș Benea a susținut că sunt dezbateri aprinse pe marginea reformei administrativ-teritoriale care vizează județele, explicând că, din punctul său de vedere, actualul sistem aparține anului 1968. Coordonatorul PSD pentru această reformă este de părere că eventualele referendumuri „nu ar face altceva decât să compromită această reorganizare administrativ-teritorială”.

latvia.title: Spitalele europene nu sunt suficient de pregătite pentru crize majore. Riscurile biologice sunt pe primul loc în topul gravității
latvia.description: Sistemele sanitare europene prezintă încă vulnerabilităţi importante în pregătirea pentru situaţii de criză majoră, inclusiv conflicte armate, atacuri asupra spitalelor şi ameninţări biologice sau chimice. Experţi ai Comisiei Europene atrag atenţia asupra noilor ameninţări la adresa sănătăţii publice şi a necesităţii consolidării rezervelor de medicamente şi echipamente medicale, în timp ce reprezentanţi ai Organizaţiei Mondiale a Sănătăţii (OMS) şi NATO subliniază importanţa pregătirii personalului şi a continuităţii îngrijirilor medicale.

latvia.title: Ministrul de Externe: NATO şi-a intensificat monitorizarea în Marea Neagră, dar nu a decis noi capabilităţi pentru România
latvia.description: NATO şi-a crescut monitorizarea în Marea Neagră şi este angajată să continue să sprijine România cu capabilităţi, însă nu există deocamdată decizii concrete privind noi contribuţii ale aliaţilor, a declarat marţi, la Bruxelles, ministrul afacerilor externe Dan Neculăescu, după întâlnirea avută la sediul Alianţei Nord-Atlantice, cu secretarul general Mark Rutte, scrie Agerpres. În declaraţii pentru […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Mayor: Narva fears humanitarian and economic consequences of the border closure
latvia.description: Narva Mayor Jaan Toots (Center Party) says that if the Estonian-Russian border is completely closed, border controls should also be reinstated on the Latvian border.

latvia.title: Egyptian citizen faces 1 year in prison for transporting migrants from Latvia to Estonia
latvia.description: A 24-year-old Egyptian citizen has been handed a one-year prison sentence under a plea agreement for transporting five foreign nationals from Latvia to Estonia who had no legal basis for staying in the country.

latvia.title: Bids being readied to buy into Latvian telecoms companies
latvia.description: Several large investors are currently preparing their offers to buy out the shares of SIA "Latvijas Mobilais Telefons" (LMT) and SIA "Tet" which are owned by "Telia Company", including one global investor who has made an official offer, according to Valdis Jalinskis, Head of Public Relations of the LMT Group.

latvia.title: Kulbergs' government declaration promises three stages of reforms
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 17 November, representatives of the United List and the National Alliance signed a political cooperation agreement and a declaration setting out the plans for Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs’ (United List) second government.

latvia.title: Līgatne's beloved bear Puika passes away aged 31
latvia.description: Puika, the brown bear – a long-standing resident of the Līgatne nature trails and a favourite with visitors – has passed away at the age of 31, according to the Nature Conservation Agency (DAP).

latvia.title: Latvian central bank calls on insurers to simplify claims procedures
latvia.description: Following a review of all eight providers of private property insurance in Latvia, Latvijas Banka, (the Latvian central bank and financial regulator) is calling on the insurance industry to overhaul its procedures to make the claims process clearer for customers.

latvia.title: Snow will replace rain at end of week in Latvia
latvia.description: From this weekend onwards, air temperatures in Latvia will drop slightly and rain will give way to snow more frequently, according to weather forecasters.

latvia.title: PM Kulbergs confirms shape of his new cabinet
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs confirmed the shape of his preferred cabinet on November 17th at a specially-convened press conference.

latvia.title: Possible fraud detected in distance school staff salaries in Latvia
latvia.description: 160 working hours a week, or four full-time positions a month, and a salary of almost 17,000 euros. In its audit, the State Audit Office has identified potential risks of fraud, focusing on private educational institutions that deliver distance-learning programmes, Latvian Television reported on November 16.

latvia.title: Rēzekne's central market redeveloped after 30 years
latvia.description: The Rēzekne Central Market on Latgales Street has undergone dramatic changes over the past year. The market area, which had not seen any improvements for more than 30 years, has become much more accessible to shoppers and more convenient for traders following its recent renovation, Latvian Radio reported on November 17.

latvia.title: Rīga picks out its Xmas trees
latvia.description: In the grey, chilly weather of November, the main Christmas trees were selected from the forests around Rīga; they will adorn Doma Square and Town Hall Square during the festive season, Latvian Television reported Monday.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 16th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Potential government outline emerges in Latvia
latvia.description: According to unofficial information available to Latvian Television, the next government led by Andris Kulbergs (United List) could include just one woman but three men named Edgars, as well as four non-partisan ministers, LTV reported on Monday evening.

latvia.title: Former footballer Gorkšs sent on to tackle Latvian civil service
latvia.description: On Monday, November 16, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs introduced the new head of the State Chancellery, and in effect the senior civil servant in the country, former football international Kaspars Gorkšs, to the State Chancellery team, wishing him success in his position.

latvia.title: National Alliance puts forward ministerial candidates
latvia.description: The National Alliance (NA) is proposing the following ministers for ministerial posts in the new government being formed by Andris Kulbergs (United List): Jānis Dombrava for the post of Minister for the Interior, Nauris Puntulis for Culture, and Ilze Indriksone, the current Minister for Education, for the post of Minister for Welfare.

latvia.title: Latvia still has highest road fatality rate in Baltics
latvia.description: In 2024, there were 20 210 road fatalities across the EU’s territory, equivalent to 45 per million inhabitants.

latvia.title: Bird influenza detected on Staicele farm
latvia.description: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 has been detected on a farm in Staicele, Limbaži region, with approximately 30 different species of poultry, according to laboratory tests conducted at the Scientific Institute of Food Safety, Animal Health and Environment (BIOR).

latvia.title: Introduction of EU 'Temu tax' had an immediate effect in Latvia
latvia.description: The introduction of a new tax on parcels arriving in Latvia from third countries has greatly reduced their number, fresh data shows.

latvia.title: Kulbergs plans to axe Climate and Energy Ministry, ponders special portfolios
latvia.description: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) signalled on Monday that he intends to shake up the shape of government, cutting at least one ministry and potentially inviting people from outside politics to take charge at other ministries.

latvia.title: First American volunteer enjoying his Latvian military service
latvia.description: "Washington" – that's the nickname given to the State Defence Service (VAD) soldier Kārlis, who has been serving in Kurzeme, in the 4th Brigade of the National Guard, for several months now. Kārlis is the first State Defense Service soldier from the United States.

latvia.title: Estonian security chief: 'I hope Latvia will take sufficient measures'
latvia.description: Estonian public media ERR News has an interesting interview with the country's security service chief concerning a recent incident in which eight Latvian nationals were arrested on suspicion of a Russia-backed sabotage plot.

latvia.title: Blood sugar check campaign shows worrying trend in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 13 November, during the Diabetes Screening Day held at Riga 1st Hospital, more than half of those who attended had blood sugar levels above the normal range, the hospital reported.

latvia.title: Latvia's Nations League campaign closes with a draw
latvia.description: Latvia's UEFA Nations League campaign for 2026 has reached a merciful conclusion, finishing with a match at home against Armenia on Sunday, November 15th.

latvia.title: Eight puppies born at Latvian Border Guard College
latvia.description: On 10 November, eight Belgian Shepherd puppies – five females and three males – were born at the Cynology Centre of the State Border Guard College’s Cynology Service. The puppies’ mother is Josie from the State Border Guard Service, the college reported.

latvia.title: Gloomy November week ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that rainfall is likely to be frequent in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: Rīga loses million euro street light project
latvia.description: Riga has lost the opportunity to use more than 740,000 euros in state funding to replace street lights. According to the Latvian Television programme “De facto” aired on November 15, the local authority selected “Vizulo Solutions” as the tender winner twice, but the Public Procurement Monitoring Bureau overturned both decisions after competitors filed complaints.

latvia.title: United List, National Alliance agree on government formation
latvia.description: The current Prime Minister, Andris Kulbergs (United List), who has been entrusted by the President with forming a new government, has announced that the United List (AS) and the National Alliance (NA) have agreed to cooperate in forming the new government, Latvian Television reported Sunday evening.

latvia.title: Icy roads in parts of Latvia Monday morning
latvia.description: On Monday, November 16, ice on the roads of Latvia creates difficult driving conditions in Vidzeme, Latgale, and around Talsi, said Latvian State Roads (LVC).

latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Eight Latvian nationals arrested over suspected Estonia drone arson plot
latvia.description: Eight Latvian nationals have been detained after an attempt to commit arson at Estonian drone manufacturer Threod Systems, reports Estonian public media ERR.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Armenia Nations League football
latvia.description: Can Latvia record a win during this Nations League campaign? Can they finish the group with more than one point? The country's top footballers have one final chance of answering these questions in the affirmative on Sunday with the final group game against Armenia in Rīga.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 13th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian Foreign Ministry proposes national 'blood grain' transit ban
latvia.description: The Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on November 13th that, in cooperation with other competent ministries, it has prepared a draft Cabinet regulation proposing a ban on the transit of grain originating in Russia and Belarus through the territory of Latvia.

latvia.title: 'We have to grow some bigger balls' recommends Latvian Prime Minister
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) did not mince his words at the informal meeting of the heads of state or government of the European Union (EU) in Dublin, Ireland, on November 13th, recommending a testosterone-filled course of action for the continent.

latvia.title: Latvia slashed its greenhouse gas emissions in Q2
latvia.description: New Eurostat data shows that in the second quarter of 2026 Latvia managed to cut its greenhouse gas emissions by an impressive amount.

latvia.title: Regional public transport ticket prices will increase by around 10% next year
latvia.description: The Public Transport Council on Friday supported an increase in fares on regional bus and train routes by an average of 10% in 2027, according to information provided by the Road Transport Directorate (ATD).

latvia.title: New Virši fueling station opens in Rīga
latvia.description: The energy trader AS ‘Virši-A’, which operates under the ‘Virši’ brand, has invested 2.2 million euros in the construction of a new full-service petrol station on Vienības gatve in Riga, the company announced on November 13.

latvia.title: Latvia's employment figures at 66% in third quarter
latvia.description: Results from the Labour Force Survey (LFS) conducted by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) show that in Latvia 897.0 thousand people, or 66.1 % of the population 1 aged 15–74, were employed in Q3 2026. Year on year, the employment rate rose only slightly overall, with increase also recorded among young people. Unemployment rate stood at 6.7 %.

latvia.title: Coalition talks nearing some result in Latvia
latvia.description: The formation of the government is nearing completion – the United List still needs to reach agreement with the National Alliance on certain issues, as stated by Māris Kučinskis, chair of the United List parliamentary group, following a meeting with President Edgars Rinkēvičs on Friday, November 13.

latvia.title: Heating in Rīga will be costly as of December
latvia.description: The heat energy tariff charged by AS ‘Rīgas siltums’ will rise by 19 per cent from 1 December to 96.33 euros per megawatt-hour (MWh), excluding value-added tax (VAT), according to information published in the official gazette “Latvijas vēstnesis”.

latvia.title: Baltic power grids face new security reality
latvia.description: The Baltic electricity system is significantly more secure than it was five years ago. But the range of threats it must withstand has also become considerably broader – from physical attacks and sabotage to cyber threats, drones and extreme weather

latvia.title: Saturday could be a snow day in northern Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that a blanket of snow will form in some parts of Vidzeme on Saturday.

latvia.title: Science body declines to place blame in citizenship controversy
latvia.description: The Senate of the Latvian Academy of Sciences (LZA) is not aware of any evidence that the President of the Academy, Ivars Kalviņš, has knowingly violated the powers set out in the academy's statutes or acted out of personal interest by recommending granting Latvian citizenship to Indian citizen Divya Kannan Vishwanath reports the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Another Nations League loss on the road for Latvia
latvia.description: The Latvian national team lost 2:1 away to group leaders Montenegro in the penultimate match of the UEFA Nations League on Thursday, November 12th.

latvia.title: Three for the Patriot Weekend: Lights, Readiness, Food
latvia.description: It's a Patriot Weekend! See what it offers.

latvia.title: Beware of wildlife on Latvia's roads as dark season sets in
latvia.description: Spotting an animal on the road sometimes means a driver has to make a decision in a matter of seconds. Experts remind us that such situations become more frequent in autumn and winter, so particular attention must be paid to driving speed and visibility, Latvian Television reports on November 13.

latvia.title: Defence industry in Latvia has expanded
latvia.description: Around 240 companies currently operate in Latvia's defence sector, and the sector’s growth is driven by rising demand for security solutions, technological developments, and more accessible financial support. Latvian companies are developing technologies such as unmanned aerial vehicles, sensors, communication systems, electronics, cyber security solutions, optics, navigation technologies and autonomous systems, Latvian Radio reported on November 13.

latvia.title: 'Iļģuciems metalhead' needs your help to make it home
latvia.description: The band ‘DJ Krankenwagen’, in collaboration with various Latvian musicians and artists, has released a video game called ‘Iļģuciems metalhead’. In it, the player takes on the role of a metal music fan and, after a concert, must make their way from the ‘Melnā piektdiena’ club back home to the Iļģuciems district in Rīga, according to the game’s creators.

latvia.title: Possible data leak issue rectified, says service provider
latvia.description: A security vulnerability has been rectified in a database containing more than 125 million text messages sent by Latvian and Lithuanian banks, insurers, retailers and service providers to their customers, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on November 12.

latvia.description: Topošajam veselības ministram Normundam Staņēvičam ir nepieciešamās profesionālās zināšanas un vadītāja pieredze, lai uzņemtos šo amatu, uzskata līdzšinējais veselības ministrs Hosams Abu Meri (JV). lithuania.title: Polska coraz bliżej Nuclear Sharing? Szef MON Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz o szczegółach
lithuania.description: Efekty są bardzo dobre akurat dla Polski, ale to wymaga już największej dyskrecji - powiedział szef MON Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, pytany o zaangażowanie Polski w program Nuclear Sharing. lithuania.title: Unia Europejska zyskuje, Polska lekko traci. Nowe prognozy Brukseli
lithuania.description: Komisja Europejska podwyższyła prognozę wzrostu gospodarczego Unii Europejskiej na 2026 rok, a jednocześnie nieznacznie obniżyła przewidywania dla Polski na 2027 rok. Wyraźnie pogorszyły się natomiast prognozy dotyczące przyszłorocznej inflacji oraz deficytu sektora finansów publicznych w Polsce.

lithuania.title: Co zrobić w razie ataku Rosji? Większość Polaków wskazała jedną odpowiedź
lithuania.description: Jak należy reagować na potencjalne rosyjskie ataki? Czy mamy pewność, że sojusznicy nam pomogą? Co sami byśmy zrobili w razie zbrojnego ataku? Najnowsze badanie CBOS pokazuje, że pierwszy raz od 2024 roku najwięcej ankietowanych Polaków uważa atak Rosji na państwa NATO za raczej nieprawdopodobny.

lithuania.title: Falošní policajti a advokáti cielia na dôverčivých seniorov. V Trnavskom kraji rastie počet nebezpečných telefonátov
lithuania.description: Na západnom Slovensku pribúdajú telefonické podvody na senioroch. Podvodníci v úlohe policajtov a advokátov zneužívajú strach o rodinu a snažia sa získať peniaze.

lithuania.title: Revizuirea efectivelor militare ale SUA din Europa, în centrul unor discuții dintre aliații NATO și adjunctul de la Pentagon
lithuania.description: Aliații NATO vor discuta marți cu Elbridge Colby, șeful departamentului de politici al Pentagonului, despre revizuirea de către Washington a efectivelor militare americane din Europa, a declarat ministrul german al apărării, Boris Pistorius, urmând ca în câteva săptămâni să se ofere mai multe detalii cu privire la amploarea unei eventuale reduceri, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: NATO își pregătește trupele de elită după modelul ucrainean. Soldații renunță la cele mai noi tehnologii pentru a supraviețui pe front
lithuania.description: Forțele speciale ale NATO își schimbă radical metodele de antrenament, după ce războiul din Ucraina a demonstrat că tehnologia militară avansată poate deveni o vulnerabilitate pe câmpul de luptă.

lithuania.title: Japonia a ridicat avioanele de vânătoare după ce două aeronave, presupuse a fi ruseşti, au pătruns în spaţiul său aerian
lithuania.description: Japonia a anunţat marţi că a mobilizat avioane de vânătoare după ce două aeronave, presupuse a fi ruseşti, i-au încălcat spaţiul aerian şi a înaintat un „protest foarte ferm” către Moscova, anunţă France24.

lithuania.title: Copiii și adolescenții văd aproape 4.000 de reclame la alimente pe an. 92% dintre produsele promovate sunt nesănătoase, arată un studiu
lithuania.description: Copiii și adolescenții din Statele Unite sunt expuși anual la aproape 4.000 de mesaje publicitare despre alimente și băuturi pe platformele digitale, iar aproximativ 92% dintre produsele alimentare analizate nu îndeplinesc criteriile nutriționale pentru o alimentație sănătoasă.

lithuania.title: NATO a anulat summitul din 2027 din Albania. Ce urmează pentru reuniunile liderilor Alianței
lithuania.description: NATO a anulat summitul liderilor statelor membre, planificat inițial pentru anul viitor la Tirana, capitala Albaniei, a confirmat Edi Rama, prim-ministrul albanez. Secretarul general Mark Rutte a declarat că Alianța este „flexibilă” și va organiza un summit al liderilor atunci când va fi necesar, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Dan Neculăescu, întâlnire cu şeful diplomaţiei poloneze: „România şi Polonia rămân doi piloni strategici pe Flancul Estic”
lithuania.description: Dan Neculăescu a discutat luni cu vicepremierul şi ministrul de externe al Poloniei, Radoslaw Sikorski, în marja reuniunii Consiliului Afaceri Externe, desfăşurată la Bruxelles. Ministrul Afacerilor Externe a subliniat importanţa cooperării dintre cele două state şi a coordonării pe Flancul Estic al NATO.

lithuania.title: PSD cere restructurarea instituţiilor şi companiilor de stat înainte de bugetul pe 2027: „Statul strânge cureaua, nu cetăţenii”
lithuania.description: Senatorii PSD susţin adoptarea bugetului de stat pentru anul 2027 după realizarea unei reforme administrative care să reducă cheltuielile publice şi să elimine instituţiile şi companiile de stat ineficiente sau ale căror atribuţii se suprapun. Social-democraţii afirmă că reorganizarea aparatului public trebuie să aibă loc înainte de definitivarea proiectului de buget.

lithuania.title: Peiu, după ce România nu a obținut șefia Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei: „De ce s-a asumat un obiectiv atât de straniu?”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a criticat luni „obiectivul straniu” asumat de România de a susţine candidatura lui Dacian Cioloş pentru funcţia de secretar general al Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei.

lithuania.title: Harta verde de la Vânătorii Mici se extinde: Pădurea DIGI crește cu încă 6.100 de puieți
lithuania.description: Vineri, 13 noiembrie, localitatea Vânătorii Mici din județul Giurgiu a găzduit, pentru al treilea an consecutiv, o nouă mobilizare a voluntarilor Grupului DIGI, dedicată regenerării unei parcele neproductive, afectate de secetă și eroziune. Reuniți sub umbrela campaniei “Pădurea DIGI. Fiecare copac, o schimbare”, 115 angajați și-au canalizat energia și eforturile pentru a îmbogăți cu peste 6.000 de puieți arealul forestier din sudul țării, alături de Asociația Act for Tomorrow, partenerul inițiativei încă de la lansare.

lithuania.title: Turos Lóránd, despre reforma administrativă propusă de PSD: „Nu poți redesena localitățile dintr-un birou din București”
lithuania.description: Reforma administrativ-teritorială propusă de PSD reprezintă „o amenințare" pentru fiecare comunitate locală din România, nu pentru UDMR, susține liderul senatorilor Uniunii, Turos Lóránd. Acesta cere ca reorganizarea să se bazeze pe date și analize tehnice și să fie realizată numai după consultarea cetățenilor și organizarea unor referendumuri în localitățile afectate.

lithuania.title: Isărescu, bilanț la aproape 20 de ani de la aderarea la UE: „A fost șansa noastră”. Cele două mari restanțe ale României
lithuania.description: România nu a reușit, în aproape două decenii de apartenență la Uniunea Europeană, să își conecteze toate regiunile prin infrastructură și să adere la zona euro, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a descris aderarea la UE drept un „proiect istoric" și „șansa" pe care România a valorificat-o, dar a atras atenția asupra investițiilor și reformelor rămase nefinalizate.

lithuania.title: Guvernatorul BNR respinge scenariul unui acord cu FMI: „Fondul vine când avem o criză valutară. Nu este cazul României"
lithuania.description: România nu se află în situația de a apela la un acord de finanțare cu Fondul Monetar Internațional, deoarece nu traversează o criză valutară și dispune de rezerve, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a precizat că țara are nevoie de finanțare, însă banii trebuie să vină din investiții străine, fonduri europene și împrumuturi de pe piețele de capital.

lithuania.title: BNR a revizuit în sus prognoza de inflație. Mugur Isărescu: „Energia și carburanții au împins estimările în creștere”
lithuania.description: Banca Națională a României a revizuit în creștere traiectoria prognozată a inflației, în principal din cauza scumpirii energiei și carburanților, a anunțat luni guvernatorul Mugur Isărescu. Rata anuală a inflației este așteptată să urce ușor până la sfârșitul anului, apoi să scadă aproape continuu și să revină în intervalul țintei în primul trimestru din 2028. Guvernatorul BNR a afirmat că prețurile de sărbători ar putea rămâne relativ stabile sau ar putea avea creșteri normale, fără scumpiri exagerate.

lithuania.title: Dezbateri aprinse pe tema comasării județelor. Dragoș Benea: „Referendumurile nu ar face altceva decât să compromită reorganizarea”
lithuania.description: Într-o intervenție telefonică la Digi24, Dragoș Benea a susținut că sunt dezbateri aprinse pe marginea reformei administrativ-teritoriale care vizează județele, explicând că, din punctul său de vedere, actualul sistem aparține anului 1968. Coordonatorul PSD pentru această reformă este de părere că eventualele referendumuri „nu ar face altceva decât să compromită această reorganizare administrativ-teritorială”.

lithuania.title: Spitalele europene nu sunt suficient de pregătite pentru crize majore. Riscurile biologice sunt pe primul loc în topul gravității
lithuania.description: Sistemele sanitare europene prezintă încă vulnerabilităţi importante în pregătirea pentru situaţii de criză majoră, inclusiv conflicte armate, atacuri asupra spitalelor şi ameninţări biologice sau chimice. Experţi ai Comisiei Europene atrag atenţia asupra noilor ameninţări la adresa sănătăţii publice şi a necesităţii consolidării rezervelor de medicamente şi echipamente medicale, în timp ce reprezentanţi ai Organizaţiei Mondiale a Sănătăţii (OMS) şi NATO subliniază importanţa pregătirii personalului şi a continuităţii îngrijirilor medicale.

lithuania.title: Ministrul de Externe: NATO şi-a intensificat monitorizarea în Marea Neagră, dar nu a decis noi capabilităţi pentru România
lithuania.description: NATO şi-a crescut monitorizarea în Marea Neagră şi este angajată să continue să sprijine România cu capabilităţi, însă nu există deocamdată decizii concrete privind noi contribuţii ale aliaţilor, a declarat marţi, la Bruxelles, ministrul afacerilor externe Dan Neculăescu, după întâlnirea avută la sediul Alianţei Nord-Atlantice, cu secretarul general Mark Rutte, scrie Agerpres. lithuania.title: Analitikas dekonstravo sėkmingą smūgį Krymo tiltui: rusams – šokas
lithuania.description: Antradienio naktį smarkiai apgadintas 19 kilometrų ilgio automobilių ir geležinkelio tiltas per Kerčės sąsiaurį, jungiantis Rusijos Tamanės pusiasalį su aneksuotu Krymo pusiasaliu. lithuania.title: Ukrainai galingai smūgiuojant – nerami Putino kelionė lydint bombonešiams

Jis išvyko į Azijos ir Ramiojo vandenyno ekonominio bendradarbiavimo organizacijos (APEC) viršūnių susitikimą Kinijos Šendženo mieste, kur turėtų susitikti su Donaldu Trumpu ir Xi Jinpingu.
